items.title: Mike Vax interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2022
items.q: he voiced out Carl Fontana’s whole trombone solo from “Kenton in Hi- Fi” he voiced out Carl Fontana’s whole trombone solo for the whole band.

ctx.x: Nowadays we’d be in court over that.

Probably so. But with “Intermission Riff” in the beginning there was no chart. It was a head chart. Ray just — they were just going to use it as a break tune so Ray just taught it to everybody. And then over the years more arrangements were done. And of course the arrangement that we play with the Kenton Legacy Orchestra that Kim Richmond did in the middle of it he voiced out Carl Fontana’s whole trombone solo from “Kenton in Hi- Fi” he voiced out Carl Fontana’s whole trombone solo for the whole band. So in the…

Oh right. And we played that too of course, at Fredonia. I wanted to change subjects a little bit here and ask you about some of your recordings. There’s one that goes back a ways, “Old Time Concert in the Park.”
